title: velvety japanese butter beans bowl
description: a sattvic-friendly, ayurvedic-inspired bowl featuring butter beans in a rich, resinous sauce, served in a stone-bowl dolsot.
instructions: rinse the butter beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours. discard the water and rinse the beans again.
in a large pot, combine the kombu seaweed, ginger, garlic, and 4 cups of water. bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 1 hour.
remove the kombu seaweed and add the butter beans, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil to the pot. bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
add the dried wakame seaweed and shredded daikon to the pot and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes.
season the bean mixture with salt to taste.
to prepare the garnish, toast the sesame seeds in a small pan over medium heat until fragrant.
just before serving, garnish the bean mixture with the toasted sesame seeds, scallions, and a sprinkle of salt.
serve the bean mixture in a stone-bowl dolsot, garnished with additional sesame seeds and scallions if desired.
